name: r6-contact-pair-standing
description: THE CONTACT PAIR v2, arm 4 of 4 — the LIVE arm's 90-tick PREFIX, and the only tape on the roster that ends MID-WINDOW. The other three all finish with `hits` back at 0 (two of them because the death reset it, one because it never took any), which makes the game's own `hits` / `hits_timer` readouts vacuous exactly where they are supposed to be evidence. This arm stops at tick 90: two hits taken (48 and 72), none healed, and the second one's i-frame window still draining — so the terminal readout is `hits: 2, hits_timer: 1` from the GAME's own statics, against a model that has to produce both numbers. Prefix-control shape: every byte is `r6-contact-pair-live`'s up to the tick count, so the two arms are the same walk stopped at different places, and the prefix's stream is the live arm's own first 91 observations.
